name: WSDL Service
description: Schema describing a service element in a WSDL 2.0 document. A service groups a set of endpoints that implement a common interface, providing the concrete network addresses where the web service is available.

name.description: The local name of the service, unique within the WSDL target namespace.

interface.description: A qualified name referencing the interface that this service implements.

endpoint.description: A list of endpoints where this service can be accessed.
